title: Remove the integration test file created in this task
body: The file tests/int/chapters-by-grade-lesson-order.int.spec.ts was created to reproduce the bug. It should be evaluated whether it's worth keeping as a regression test or removed if it proves flaky/brittle.
rationale: The test creates its own MongoDB container and exercises prefetchStudyData with out-of-order lessons, which is complex. It may not catch real regressions if the DB always returns lessons in order anyway.
